presentation.description: An MCP server and CLI that let Claude Code, a script or another Codex agent run Codex agents: queued, kept off each other's files, with their questions and results returned to the orchestrator.

features.title: Agents that run agents
features.description: Hand Pelican a brief and it runs a Codex agent. Parallel agents queue and take turns on the files they claim.

features.title: Questions come back
features.description: An agent that needs a decision asks the orchestrator that spawned it, and its result returns checked against a schema.

features.title: Nothing left running
features.description: Pelican starts when something needs it and exits when nothing does.
